news.title: De route naar groei: wat de tocht van Workwize zegt over het Nederlandse investeringslandschap

summary: Workwize is dutch software as a service company for IT equipment management, founded in 2021. Type: startup / scale-up. Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 3 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 1 about growth or hiring.

culture.text: IT teams use its platform to equip and manage remote and global workforces, with 50,000 users and 120,000 devices under management.
